name: Cloud Autosave
description: Automatically saves your Geometry Dash account to the official servers (same as the Save button in the account menu).

save-on-new-best.name: Save on new best
save-on-new-best.description: Save your account every time you get a new best on a level.

save-on-stat-change.name: Save when account stats change
save-on-stat-change.description: Save when stars, moons, demons, secret coins, user coins or diamonds change (for example after completing a level).

cooldown.name: Minimum time between saves (seconds)
cooldown.description: Saves requested during this time are delayed, so the servers are not spammed.

show-notifications.name: Show notifications
show-notifications.description: Show a notification when a save succeeds or fails.
